action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that pecl_http incorrectly handled certain HTTP request
parameters, leading to a type confusion. A remote attacker could possibly
use this issue to cause PHP to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or
execute arbitrary code.
isummary:
pecl_http could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially
crafted network traffic.
title: pecl_http vulnerability
